notes: WARNING: every material and actuation number in this file is an ARBITRARY
PLACEHOLDER chosen only so that the viewer shows plausible motion.
None of these values has been measured on a catheter. They must never be
quoted as device properties, and no result produced with this profile is
mechanically valid. Use it to exercise the software, nothing else.
Replace with bench-calibrated values (docs/validation-plan.md) before any
How the damping numbers were picked (so they are reproducible rather than
invented): the over-damped rod relaxes with time constant tau = c_total/k.
Targeting tau = 0.5 s at the nominal deployed length L = 110.0 mm gives
c = tau * (3 EI / L^3) / L = 1.77e-05 N s / mm^2 and
c_torsion = tau * (GJ / L) / L = 0.0509 N mm s / rad per mm.
They set how fast the demo settles; they are NOT measured catheter damping.
